Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Forgiver of mistakes, forgive my mistake
O Answerer of prayers, answer my prayer
O Hearer of voices, hear my voice

Arabic text: وَارْحَمْنِيْ وَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْ سَيِّئاتِيْ وَمَا عِنْدِيْ
Translation: And have mercy on me and overlook my sins and what I have
O Lord of Majesty and Honor
